change_summary: Added warehouse-backed OHLCV settlement for the default-off options forward ledger and daily runner fallback when no manual OPTIONS_FORWARD_OHLCV_SNAPSHOT is supplied.
component: quant/experiments/exp_20260709_017_options_forward_ohlcv_autowire.py, scripts/run_options_forward_ledger.py, quant/run.py, quant/test_run_daily_wiring.py, data/experiments/exp-20260709-017/exp_20260709_017_options_forward_ohlcv_autowire.json, data/experiments/exp-20260709-017/options_forward/, experiments/cards/exp-20260709-017.md, experiments/manifests/exp-20260709-017.json, experiments/tickets/exp-20260709-017.json, experiments/logs/exp-20260709-017.json, docs/experiment_log.jsonl, docs/experiment_registry.json
hypothesis: Repair options_forward daily settlement wiring so default-off options candidate rows can accumulate closed OHLCV outcomes without requiring a manual OPTIONS_FORWARD_OHLCV_SNAPSHOT env var.
notes: Measurement repair: before report had 175/175 outcome_status=ohlcv_snapshot_missing and zero closed scoring-allowed outcomes; after warehouse settlement produced closed scoring-allowed horizons 5d=14, 10d=12, 20d=9 while preserving shadow-only/default-off production impact. Alpha hypothesis remains untested; next options alpha requires materially more settled forward rows and Gate 1-4.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune or promote squeeze/downside options overlays from this small observed-only repaired sample; prior options overlay alpha was rejected and this run only fixed settlement plumbing.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Materially more settled options_forward rows, preferably after warehouse OHLCV extends beyond 2026-06-15, followed by shared-paper-first Gate 1-4 before any alpha promotion.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: The daily options forward ledger had candidate and option-chain rows, but no OHLCV settlement input unless OPTIONS_FORWARD_OHLCV_SNAPSHOT was manually supplied. The JSON snapshots stop before most current option-chain rows, while warehouse_main.sqlite covers enough May-June 2026 OHLCV to close 5/10/20 day outcomes.
